status: EXPLORATORY and POST HOC: defined by the coordinator after the main replay and addendum 2 were seen. Jaaks was already opened. No verdict category. Earlier plans unchanged.
question: R (p_sv) sees other lines' validation-orientation measurements, S (history_mean of the screen label) does not. Does R's gain under scheduler V come from the extra history information or from modelling confirmation (P(screen call AND validation call))?
data_access: one new common.exposed_ticket(..., 'allocation') then the frozen jaaks.build_panels; lines built exactly as in replay.build_lines
scheduler: V = verify_hits_terminal only (verify pending hits first by screen label; screen in the arm's order; reserve ceil(sum p_s x c_v) in round R with p_s = history screen-call rate for every arm; terminal verification round R+1; leftover to terminal screens in the arm's order). Measurement (B = M) and physical (B = W, cost 14 x design plates) versions; budgets, rounds, carry-over and seeds as in plan.json.
history: other lines of the same panel (same tissue, same swap replicate); per pair, shrunk mean (sum over history lines of z + k0 x mu_z) / (n + k0) with k0 = WorldConfig.shrink = 2.0 and mu_z the pooled history mean of z; target-line labels never enter

arms.S: reference: history_mean of the screen-orientation label (TransferWorld X_target[:, 0]); must reproduce verify_hits_terminal (252.5 measurement, 251.5 physical)
arms.R: reference: p_sv = shrunk history P(screen call AND validation call); must reproduce addendum-2 R+V (269.0 measurement, 264.5 physical)
arms.S_both: shrunk history mean of z = (screen-orientation label + validation-orientation label) / 2
arms.S_valid: shrunk history mean of z = validation-orientation label
arms.S_vrate: shrunk history validation-call rate, z = 1[validation call] (same k0 shrinkage toward the pooled rate)
arms.order: new screens by the arm's score descending, ties by history_mean then rng (default_rng(line index)), as in addendum 2

labels: screen-orientation label = panel.library.y; validation-orientation label = panel.valid_y (100 x max over anchor concentrations of mean SYNERGY_DELTA_EMAX of the other orientation); validation call = panel.valid_hit
checks: S purchases equal replay verify_hits_terminal; R purchases equal addendum-2 R+V (counts of mismatches reported)
the recomputed shrunk screen-label mean equals line.static (max absolute difference reported)
every history validation label is finite
endpoints: confirmation rate = confirmed / verified screen hits

contrasts.inference: verdict.contrast: paired line differences, line-stratified percentile bootstrap by tissue, 10,000 resamples, seed 20261003; line = mean of SV and VS; 125 lines

stopping_rule: one execution after synthetic tests and one dry run; reproduction failures are reported as found
code: allocation/addendum_3_information.py and allocation/test_addendum_3.py; replay.py and addendum_2x2.py are imported, not edited
